extDesc.message: Ultra-fast, elegant ad & tracker blocker. Token-indexed filtering engine, EasyList compatible, zero data collection.

opt_enable_hint.message: Master switch — turns all network and cosmetic filtering on or off.

opt_cosmetic_hint.message: Hides ad placeholders using EasyList generic CSS rules. Disable if a site looks broken.

opt_scriptlets_hint.message: Neutralises ads that network blocking cannot reach, notably on YouTube. Turn off to check whether a broken site is broken because of them.

opt_language_hint.message: By default SandBlock follows your browser's language, falling back to English.

opt_debug_hint.message: Records every action taken on the pages you visit: blocked requests, injected CSS, scriptlets and their errors. Turn on before reproducing a problem, then copy.

opt_debug_off.message: Logging is off. Turn it on, reload the problem page, then come back here.

opt_debug_empty.message: Nothing recorded yet. Reload the problem page in another tab, then click Refresh.

opt_lists_hint.message: Lists are refreshed automatically every 24 hours.

opt_user_filters_hint.message: One filter per line, EasyList / Adblock Plus syntax (e.g. ||ads.example.com^ or example.com##.banner).

opt_whitelist_hint.message: One hostname per line (e.g. example.com). SandBlock is fully disabled on these sites.

opt_dash_hint.message: The last 30 days, kept on your device only. Nothing is ever sent anywhere.

opt_dash_empty.message: Nothing recorded yet. Browse a little and come back.

opt_dash_note.message: This history stays in the browser. Anyone using this computer can read it, so clear it if you share the machine.

opt_about.message: SandBlock is open source, collects no data, and runs entirely on your device.

trouble_cta.message: Page not working? Turn off here
trouble_cta.description: Popup: escape hatch shown when a site may be broken

zap_tip.description: Popup: title of the element-hiding button

zap_banner.message: Click an element to hide it

review_rate.description: Popup: opens the AMO review page

review_later.description: Popup: dismisses the invitation for good
